topic: Frequency log deployment for specific companies
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging and deploying a frequency log feature. Initially, [p1] requested that the `/v2/frequency_log_reg_ch` endpoint be used with the argument "Latvia" for companies 7873 and 7939, initially only on staging.

[me] confirmed initial implementation. Later, after observing discrepancies (specifically 'freq 1' for company 7939), [me] realized that the data-api had deployed analytics instead of the intended functionality. A fix was needed, and [p1] requested a production deployment immediately for those companies.

After a discussion regarding best practices (beta review vs. direct production release), [me] ultimately decided to proceed with the production deployment.
decisions: The `/v2/frequency_log_reg_ch` endpoint must be used with "Latvia" for companies 7873 and 7939.
A fix was deployed to resolve data discrepancies, moving from staging to production.
action_items: Deployment of the corrected frequency log functionality to production for companies 7873 and 7939.
